items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the three stages and (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored. Its method follows the proof at 741-765: subtract the old scratch effect, inject, undo, then cancel coefficients and compose forward/inverse/forward. The explicit coefficient values (|S cap T| mod 2, (|S cap T|-1)/2) are only described as 'intersection-size coefficients'.
It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, and derives them by the stored = frame(logical) invariant and commutation with the pointwise gate, as at 804-817.

The comparable nondegenerate labels, the single decreasing edge type (center 3->4, loss h) and L/N=100/539, 101/539 < 1/2 are all stated. The budget sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are never given; N3 says only 'below W m'. The telescoping at gates (signed sum Wm-2N, 1066-1071) and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (861-870) are missing from the derivation.

It gives the projection assignment, the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, and s_b<W_b m with deficit N-2L_b. The derivation omits the essential exception at 1162-1165: the N source edges of X_a have difference 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero. The method instead claims every edge difference is a projection whose rank is the dimension change.

The kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m and telescoping to C^{tensor m} are stated. The frames are given as bare phases i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, without the H^{tensor m} conjugation of 1193, and the plan skips the Hadamard step (1254-1257) that turns the character (-1)^{v.x} into the translation X_v. Weight additivity mod 4 and the C=iZC^{-1}Z fix for the 27k inverse factors are faithful.

N6 states that both relative deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, so s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}; N3.2 and N4.1 give L<N/2 and s<Wm. The exact eta values and the step log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}) (1332-1338) are absent, so this is not a derivation.

Splits, merges, digit moves, cyclic row splitting, controlled shifts and unit multiplication are stated and derived by the paper's aligned-stream and cut-and-remerge arguments (519, 577-603). T2 omits the hypothesis that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time (566).

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 and the bound of exactly a interchanges plus O(V) are stated and derived by the paper's pivot choice (topmost row, rightmost entry) and by two controlled shifts around one interchange. The statement drops the requirement that q be a fixed odd prime avoiding the table's denominators (1397, 1413-1423).

The plan covers the role-stream split, the shear frames on edges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, s calls on volume V/W, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with its geometric sum, and the fixed-tape DFS schedule at O(V) per node. All of this matches 1491-1588.

It derives the bound by the paper's construction: the top rho digits supply the row field, rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the width is decomposed in base m with a geometric cost sum, and binary ranges are padded to [q^e].

It covers conjugation by P_M, one child on f axes per residual basis vector (s_c in all), inverse children via C^{-1}=-iZCZ with no extra call, M as elementary row additions on slots, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. All of this matches 1878-1931.

It covers the eight packed rotations (swap, controlled shift, undo), the bad set from guards outside [10,2^{K-1}-11] with fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, repair by radix sort, the final two-bit XOR, and the cost O(V(L^tau+1)) plus terms that vanish in the parameter family. One wording slip in L1.3.1 is listed under errors.

The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the rows u=Wg+w, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the base-m pieces to O(d^{lambda'}) are present. L2.3 says the recurrence 'sums to O(e^lambda)' and drops the leaf cutoff e<d^beta, the leaf contribution O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), K<=e^{c/beta}, and the condition lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (2402-2444).

It gives O(Vd^{lambda'}), exact evaluation with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, epsilon C_1<1 making Delta=o(p), and a single truncation with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}. This follows 2479-2586 and the proof at 2686-2757.

It covers character cancellation by shifting k, the decimation-in-frequency recursion, the bit-reversed stored order with B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}. All of this matches the paper.
It covers evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, centered-residue extraction, the negacyclic wrap and O(rp log(rp)), matching 3249-3335.
It covers the retained LB order, the pointwise signed-packed products, the opposite transform and exact scaling by M, with error 3 delta + eta before scaling, giving sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}.

It gives P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with the permutations kept in the identity, derived through the left inverse D N^{-1} C, plus the HvdH ordered algorithms, the tensor form and the O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) axis movement.
It covers the Bluestein identity by comparing coefficients and the cancellation of R through R F^+ R = F^+ (dilation substitution) plus the normalized convolution rule, giving (u*v)/S^2.

It gives the fixed rationals, the sizes b, p, d, K, T with Tp=Theta(n), alpha and gamma=o(b), the prime intervals from HvdH Lemma 5.1, gcd=1, T/2<S<T and trial division. eta=1/(4d) is not named, but nothing is misstated.
It covers the algebra isomorphism x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, the triangular prefix-controlled shifts and axis reversal by O(d^2) chunk interchanges at O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.

It covers well-definedness from (zeta y)^r=1, the diagonal invertibility, the wrap factor zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and the twist approximations, matching 4303-4320. The formula M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(...) is described in words only.

It covers the source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart R F_s, the opposite transform by conjugation, the steps Phi, transforms, product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries, and the role of the two S factors.
It covers contraction error propagation, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the cancellation lemma for the opposite transform, the final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries, as at 4641-4790.
It covers the normalized cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum g_2=2^{-181}=2 kappa, absorption of log factors by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff.
R relies on 'nlogn-conjecture' and states the O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) bound, but no step states the eventual lower bound or the liminf argument that refutes it.

errors.says: The method says edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change.
errors.paper: This holds for nested labels, but the N source edges of X_a are exceptions: their difference is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero. This is why s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and not W_b m-2N+2L_b.

errors.says: Compose two three-cycles on the parity pairs (u,w) into a transposition.
errors.paper: The composite of (00 01 10) and (01 10 11) is (00 10)(01 11), a product of two disjoint transpositions that flips the parity of u and fixes w.

errors.says: With a=s/W<m^lambda, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda).
errors.paper: The internal costs sum to O(e^lambda), using a<=m^sigma<m^lambda and tau(1+c/beta)<lambda with K<=e^{c/beta}. The leaves below d^beta add O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}.

errors.says: Whole rows are dealt into W role streams, with the row count padded per prefix to a multiple of W.
errors.paper: No padding is done inside the power-width interchange: its hypothesis is a row field divisible by W^k, and the padding to a multiple of W^k happens in the arbitrary-width lemma.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, bit and complex interfaces with s<Wm and tau=1-2^{-50}, then the interchange and layer recurrences, then transforms, resampling and chirp, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table up to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The argument thins at the rank budget: the identity sum|Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is never stated, and the rank-one exception at the N source edges is only alluded to, so s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is visible only through the deficit N-2L_b. The layer recurrence's leaf term and the lambda' condition are also missing.

steps.note: N1 gives the fixed copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the three stages, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of every scratch wire; N3 gives m as dim F^{tensor 3} from triple indicator vectors. h=100 and N=binom(h,3)^3 are never given numerically; N appears only as the number of data banks.
N2 states D_out S D_in^{-1}, the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, and that each edge costs only D_v D_u^{-1}.
N3 and N3.1 give nondegenerate subspace labels in the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges as center 3->4, each losing h.

The N4 method says the edge difference of nested projections has rank equal to the dimension change. The exception of the N rank-one source edges is only alluded to ('extra source ranks' in N3.2), and N4 misstates it as universal. The core mechanism is present, so it counts, with that caveat.
The plan says only that the total dimension change is below Wm, and gives the deficit N-2L_b. The budget Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and the formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are not stated.
N3.2 gives L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, and N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.
N4 and N4.2 give M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, and C1.1.a turns this into H<-H+D on every row.
The plan gives A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) for a rank-a shear, and s recursive calls per node.
The plan gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau to F_k=O(e^tau), and tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}. The inequality log m<20 is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving with its key quantities: the exchange network, frames, labels whose only loss is h on central wires, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-a shears as a interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak link is the budget: Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are absent, and the rank-one source exception that produces s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b appears only as an allusion.
